name: phones
description: Detect phones on USB and read their details — no developer mode required.

tools.name: phones.detect
tools.description: Detect phones on the USB bus and read details via MTP (any Android, no dev mode), adb (if USB debugging is enabled), or libimobiledevice (iPhone). Includes a hint when nothing is found.

probe.description: Run MTP/adb probes on detected phones. Default true.

tools.name: phones.watch
tools.description: Watch the USB bus for plug/unplug events for a bounded window (5-600s, default 60) and report phones as they appear. Events are appended to a persistent log.

seconds.description: Watch window length in seconds. Default 60.

tools.name: phones.log
tools.description: Show the last plug/unplug events recorded by phones.watch.

limit.description: Number of events to show. Default 50.
